memories.text: I stand under the shop canopy on the main street. The pawn shop is nearby.
There is a warehouse district not far from the shops.
Dufus is the friendly fool who wanders the street. He is wearing his hat but keeps asking about it.
My vegetable truck is right here on main street. This is my post — I am always here.
Woke at the motel at 08:00. Time to head to the truck.
Woke at motel, now heading to truck on main street at 08:00 to start the day.
Morning routine: woke at motel, heading to truck for 08:00 opening shift.
08:00 — arrived at truck, ready for morning customers.
